checks.actual_history_transition: Only actual fresh durable Keep Data removal issues the receipt. Existing active record UID/full identity/add-time must agree; absent history is not fabricated; actual durable move preserves unknown bytes and CAS/intent/recovery fences.
checks.capture_ownership: Only private ManualTagStore construction creates the move-only owning capture; healthy current Store, worker, SAME OFD/lease, selected hash and equal complete candidate snapshots are checked. This is tag text, never removal/payload authority.
checks.optional_tags: Nonempty supported capture supplies replacement text. Empty/disabled/unavailable capture preserves prior tags. Unavailable/stale BEFORE receipt issue is auxiliary; warning appears only when saved.changed confirms history movement. A tag-candidate mutation AFTER receipt issue is an essential immutable receipt/history-CAS refusal, not a supported optional downgrade.
checks.ordering_and_utf8: Bounded strict UTF8 decoding rejects malformed, overlong, surrogate and out-of-range scalars and reference-property differences. Common Java17/26 UTF16 digit-run/lowercase/group-null-last comparison is reused byte-exact. Distinct output names tied by comparison are refused; no invented stable order or normalization.
checks.preservation: Current completion consumption before forget, compressed removal-cache fixture preimages and I2P Actor90s CMake timeout are preserved. The patch changes no engine stop/grant/protocol behavior.
checks.prestop_order_and_gate: Displayed-plan validation precedes capture; capture returns before checkpoint, stop, completion consumption and forget. Captured Data retains lease/candidates/names, not a source gate. Final cooperative source gate starts after retirement/waits.

prior_value_evidence.reuse: Prior4318 actual value proof only, not rerun or restamped as new Native integration.
